scope: Read-only sentence and contract audit; outputs only in refine-logs.

register.required_boundary: Keep known truth, matched endpoints, OUTSIDE TARGET and failed promotion; do not claim broad fairness or superiority.

contract_verdict.simulation_truth: DGP truth is independent of fitted predictions within the synthetic route, but is not independent empirical ground truth.
contract_verdict.claim_ceiling: simulation_only; no broad empirical fairness or superiority claim is licensed.
contract_verdict.native_gate: M2C native_gate=PASS is E3-1 classification-gate status only; the manuscript N=20 native endpoint gate remains negative with no promotion.
contract_verdict.e4_r3: WARN; E4-R006 and E4-R007 activation BLOCKED; manuscript promotion prohibited.

patch_units.current: All methods are evaluated against the known generating objects.
patch_units.proposed: In this controlled simulation benchmark, all methods are evaluated against objects generated by the declared DGP; these objects are simulation truth, not independent empirical ground truth.

patch_units.current: Effective-operator error compares reconstructed and true A_t+B_tW_t paths; response error compares horizon-truncated responses under the same topology and horizon.
patch_units.proposed: In the simulation-only design, these errors compare reconstructed paths with DGP-generated paths under the declared topology, horizon and stabilization rule; they are not empirical calibration or general-performance evidence.

patch_units.current: Network-component and frozen-topology outputs are outside the ablation target; endpoint assignment precedes numerical comparison.
patch_units.proposed: Network-component and frozen-topology outputs are marked OUTSIDE TARGET before numerical comparison; this mark is not a zero error, missing observation or failed estimate.

patch_units.current: Across 20 replications at N=15 and N=30, CP reduced effective-operator and finite-horizon response error relative to unrestricted rolling.
patch_units.proposed: Across 20 replications at N=15 and N=30 in the declared controlled simulation DGP, CP reduced the reported errors relative to unrestricted rolling for the declared endpoint and comparator.

patch_units.current: This evidence supports a specific capability; the claim is tied to the endpoint, comparator and controlled regime.
patch_units.proposed: Within this controlled simulation DGP, the evidence supports only the bounded tested-endpoint statement; it is not evidence of independent empirical ground truth, fairness, native held-out recovery, cross-family generality or broad superiority.

patch_units.current: OUTSIDE TARGET denotes an unavailable readout, not a zero-valued estimate or missing error score; projected graph-feature diagnostics are not a main-text native ranking.
patch_units.proposed: OUTSIDE TARGET denotes an unavailable readout, not a zero-valued estimate, missing score or failed estimate; projected graph-feature diagnostics are not native comparisons and do not license fairness or superiority ranking.

patch_units.current: The primary result has replicated N=15/N=30 controlled rows and common endpoints; the endpoint-aware qualification is not used to extend the gains.
patch_units.proposed: The primary result has replicated N=15/N=30 controlled simulation-only rows and common endpoints; the gain is not independent empirical validation, native held-out recovery, fairness or superiority outside the stated regime.

patch_units.current: Availability precedes numerical ranking and failure/stability records travel with errors; every score corresponds to a declared endpoint.
patch_units.proposed: Within this controlled simulation benchmark, availability precedes numerical ranking and failure/stability records travel with errors; scores attach only to declared endpoints and do not establish empirical or universal performance.

patch_units.current: An outside-target mark is not a numerical zero, missing observation or failed estimate.
patch_units.proposed: An OUTSIDE TARGET mark is not a numerical zero, missing observation or failed estimate; it is assigned before numerical scoring.

patch_units.current: Separated CP reduced controlled N=15/N=30 errors; the statement is limited to the DGP, endpoint, comparator and rows and is not evidence of native held-out recovery, broad superiority, cross-family generality or application performance.
patch_units.proposed: In the controlled simulation benchmark, separated CP reduced the reported errors; DGP-generated objects are simulation truth, not independent empirical ground truth. The statement is not evidence of native held-out recovery, empirical fairness, broad superiority, cross-family generality or application performance.

patch_units.current: Projected graph-feature rows are diagnostic, not native comparisons; future comparisons require the same native endpoint, matched inputs, tuning, horizon and stability treatment.
patch_units.proposed: Keep the diagnostic boundary; a projection does not create independent empirical ground truth. Future comparisons also require held-out and provenance records frozen in advance.

patch_units.current: The endpoint-aware N=20/T=200 experiment had CP 0/16, Tucker 6/16, both native-design 0/8, and no candidate met promotion.
patch_units.proposed: Label this experiment simulation-only and retain CP 0/16, Tucker 6/16, both native-design 0/8 and no promotion. M2C native_gate=PASS is classification-gate status only, not empirical ground truth or native recovery.

patch_units.current: The qualification fixes the inheritance boundary: the controlled gain supports its rows and comparator, not broad endpoint-aware or native held-out recovery.
patch_units.proposed: The qualification fixes the inheritance boundary: the controlled simulation gain supports only its rows and comparator, not independent empirical ground truth, broad endpoint-aware recovery, native held-out recovery, fairness or broad superiority.

forbidden_claims: simulation truth is independent empirical ground truth
native held-out recovery inherited from matched-design gain
E4-r3 empirical calibration or validity beyond H=4
OUTSIDE TARGET is zero error or failed estimate
M2C native_gate=PASS means native recovery promotion
N=20 negative gate proves universal estimator failure
